fields.Name: T091 - Entity Form Section Manager Reorder Drawer
fields.Description: Exercises the section-manager drawer (OnManageSections → mj-section-manager with OnMoveUp/OnMoveDown/OnReset) — a distinct section-ordering UI separate from expand/collapse and from section search.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box, click a member row, then 'Open Full Record'. In the form toolbar's section controls there is a 'Manage section order' icon button (bars-staggered icon). Click it to open the 'Manage Sections' drawer, which lists the form's sections each with up/down arrow buttons and a 'Reset to Default Order' button at the bottom. Success is the Manage Sections drawer rendering with the section list and reorder controls — you do NOT need to actually reorder or save. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking the 'Manage section order' toolbar button opens a 'Manage Sections' drawer
The drawer lists the form's sections with up/down move buttons and a 'Reset to Default Order' option
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
